claude_proposed_widenings.name: linked_multi_companion_activation
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The existing magic-item `spawned_creature` family creates one companion per activation. This unit has a named variant whose core rule is activating one or two linked figurines together, so a single-companion payload cannot represent it honestly.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Golden Lions (Rare). These gold statuettes of lions are always created in pairs. You can use one figurine or both simultaneously.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: elapsed_time_charge_drain_with_forced_revert
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Current activated magic items spend charges at activation time and reset on a cadence. This variant spends charges while the creature remains transformed, then auto-reverts and starts a cooldown when the pool empties.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Goat of Traveling. It has 24 charges, and each hour or portion thereof it spends in goat form costs 1 charge. When it runs out of charges, it reverts to a figurine and can't be used again until 7 days have passed, when it regains all expended charges.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: active_companion_state_gate
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Some variants grant owner-facing abilities or extra mechanics only while the figurine is in creature form. The current surface has equipment predicates, but no predicate keyed to an active spawned-companion state.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Silver Raven (Uncommon). While in raven form, the figurine grants you the ability to cast Animal Messenger on it.
